# `lora` — `/api/lora`

LoRA router — training projects: source photos, dataset preparation, captions (by hand or Florence-2), SDXL LoRA training through kohya_ss with live progress, and the trained files.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/lora/base-models`](#get-api-lora-base-models) | SDXL checkpoints available for training (reuses tools.py's SD_CHECKPOINTS). |
| GET | [`/api/lora/projects`](#get-api-lora-projects) | List all LoRA training projects, newest first. |
| POST | [`/api/lora/projects`](#post-api-lora-projects) | Create a project, either against a fresh upload folder or an existing one on disk. |
| GET | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}`](#get-api-lora-projects-project-id) | Project row, merged with live job status if one is running. |
| DELETE | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}`](#delete-api-lora-projects-project-id) | Remove a project; optionally delete its files too. |
| GET | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/captions`](#get-api-lora-projects-project-id-captions) | Every dataset image with its current caption. |
| PUT | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/captions/{filename}`](#put-api-lora-projects-project-id-captions-filename) | Hand-edit a single caption. |
| POST | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/captions/{filename}/auto`](#post-api-lora-projects-project-id-captions-filename-auto) | One-click Florence-2 caption for a single dataset image (roadmap 4.3's first concrete instance: wiring an already-generated-media GPU tool back into a flow that can use it, rather than Florence-2 captioning and LoRA dataset prep being two unconnected features). |
| GET | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/images/{filename}`](#get-api-lora-projects-project-id-images-filename) | Serve a dataset image for thumbnails. |
| GET | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/output`](#get-api-lora-projects-project-id-output) | List trained LoRA files. |
| GET | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/output/{filename}`](#get-api-lora-projects-project-id-output-filename) | Download a trained LoRA file. |
| GET | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/photos`](#get-api-lora-projects-project-id-photos) | Every raw source photo uploaded so far, for review/cleanup before dataset prep (dedup, rename) rather than after. |
| PUT | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/photos/{filename}`](#put-api-lora-projects-project-id-photos-filename) | Rename a source photo (extension is kept as-is; only the name before it is editable). |
| DELETE | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/photos/{filename}`](#delete-api-lora-projects-project-id-photos-filename) | Remove a duplicate/unwanted source photo. |

| GET | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/source-images/{filename}`](#get-api-lora-projects-project-id-source-images-filename) | Serve a raw source photo for thumbnails. |
| POST | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/train`](#post-api-lora-projects-project-id-train) | Launch SDXL LoRA training with live progress tracking. |
| POST | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/train/cancel`](#post-api-lora-projects-project-id-train-cancel) | SIGTERM the training process group, SIGKILL after a grace period. |
| GET | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/train/status`](#get-api-lora-projects-project-id-train-status) | Poll live training progress. |
| POST | [`/api/lora/projects/{project_id}/upload`](#post-api-lora-projects-project-id-upload) | Add photos into the project's source folder. |

List all LoRA training projects, newest first.

<a id="post-api-lora-projects-project-id-captions-filename-auto"></a>
### `POST /api/lora/projects/{project_id}/captions/{filename}/auto`

One-click Florence-2 caption for a single dataset image (roadmap 4.3's first concrete instance: wiring an already-generated-media GPU tool back into a flow that can use it, rather than Florence-2 captioning and LoRA dataset prep being two unconnected features). Writes the result to the same .txt file update_caption() writes to, and returns it the same shape — the frontend can treat this as "pre-fill, then let the user edit," not a black box.

- Handler: [`auto_caption`](../../../backend/routers/lora.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | path | integer | yes |  |  |
| `filename` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `filename`, `caption`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Dataset not prepared yet | `auto_caption` |
| 400 | Invalid filename | `_resolve_in_dir` |

| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="get-api-lora-styles"></a>
### `GET /api/lora/styles`

Trained LoRAs available for use as a Design Center style chip.

Only projects that finished training AND were successfully copied into A1111's Lora dir (a1111_lora_filename set) qualify — that's what makes <lora:name:weight> actually resolve in a generation call.

- Handler: [`list_styles`](../../../backend/routers/lora.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON list, each item JSON object with `id`, `label`, `lora_name`, `base_style`
